---
title: "Macros from multiple style files"
format: math-web-html
math-web:
  macros:
    - example-macros.sty
    - extra-macros.sty
---

The files are read in the listed order. `extra-macros.sty` defines $\plane$
using $\RR$ from `example-macros.sty`.

The second file also renews `\shift`, changing its optional default to $z$:

$$\shift{y} \qquad \shift[x]{y}$$

Declarations from the first file remain available:

$$\pair{x}{y} \qquad \rankop(A)$$

To use KaTeX, add `html-math-method: katex` to the front matter.
